approved: Primary Industries (Consequential Amendments and Transitional Provisions) Bill 2023
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill is part of a set of laws that would update the national system for agricultural levies.
It would repeal outdated Acts and make changes to other laws to support the transition to a modernised framework.
The bill would also move rules about paying out levy funds and matching government contributions into a new separate law.
Repeals Acts that would be redundant when the new system starts.
Makes amendments to Commonwealth legislation to support the transition.
Removes provisions from the Primary Industries Research and Development Act 1989 and the Wine Australia Act 2013 about disbursement of levy amounts and matching funding.
Sets out application, savings and transitional arrangements to keep the levy system running without interruption.
Farmers, producers, processors, exporters, collection agents and levy recipient bodies would be affected.
